Then, using the final values 𝑿 \boldsymbol{X} and 𝑾 \boldsymbol{W} as the starting point, we optimize the usual modified loss function. Using this procedure, we had Mod-GCN mimic the strategy of Full-Color by first having it use the unique 1 1 -coloring as the starting point to produce a 2 2 -coloring, then having it use that 2 2 -coloring as the starting point to produce a 3 3 -coloring, and so on. The decision to use p i , φ ​ ( i ) ′ = 0.55 p^{\prime}_{i,\varphi(i)}=0.55 rather than a different value came from testing a range of values.
